query: Turn sops/onboarding-checklist.md (a 180-line procedure doc) into a harness skill.
expected_behavior: Creates dot-claude/skills/<gerund-name>/SKILL.md with a third-person description that says what it does and 'Use when …'

Moves long tables/rationale into reference/ files linked directly from SKILL.md, runs scripts/check-skills.sh and fixes findings until clean

expected_behavior: Refuses or corrects the name to a gerund form (e.g. 'deploying-releases') — 'helper' is vague and not gerund
Rewrites the description in third person with concrete triggers ('Deploys … Use when the owner says deploy …')
Runs scripts/check-skills.sh and reports a clean result
